title: Neural Network Fractional Quantum Hall States with Learnable Orbital Pair Matrix Factors: Balancing Physical Priors and Flexibility
title_zh: 具有可学习轨道对矩阵因子的神经网络分数量子霍尔态：平衡物理先验和灵活性
summary: 神经网络分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 态为捕获朗道级 (LL) 混合和理解 FQH 物理提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但迄今为止，物理先验的结合仅限于 ansatz 中内置的最小精确约束。在球面几何中，我们表明，当仅提供最小的附加物理先验时，以及当严格地施加诸如通量附加之类的先验时，网络的灵活性都会受到影响。在前一种情况下，单极子谐波积轨道（MHPO）模拟很难优化，而在后一种情况下，神经网络的表达能力受到限制。
abstract: arXiv:2610.28095v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural network fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states offer a promising alternative for capturing Landau level (LL) mixing and for understanding FQH physics, yet the incorporation of physical priors has so far been limited to the minimal exact constraints built into the ansatz. Working in spherical geometry, we show that the network's flexibility suffers both when only minimal additional physical priors are supplied and when priors such as flux attachment are imposed rigidly. In the former case, the monopole harmonic product orbital (MHPO) ansatz is difficult to optimize, whereas in the latter, the expressivity of the neural network is restricted. We therefore propose the orbital pair matrix factor MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz, which balances physical priors against flexibility by not only replacing the fixed Laughlin structure with learnable pair factors but also making them dependent on both the electron configurations and the orbitals. Across ν=1/5, 1/3, and 2/5, MHPO-M achieves the lowest variational energy among the tested variants, and a factorized orbital readout based on it enables scaling to 35 electrons, with energies competitive with trends inferred from three-LL exact-diagonalization results. These results demonstrate that physical priors can be appropriately incorporated without sacrificing the flexibility of neural network wavefunctions, opening a promising path toward accurate, scalable modeling of FQH systems with LL mixing.

title: MOFFieldBench: A Machine Learning Benchmark for Continuous Electronic Fields in Metal-Organic Frameworks
title_zh: MOFFieldBench：金属有机框架中连续电子场的机器学习基准
summary: 金属有机框架（MOF）的机器学习模型主要依赖于原子结构，而电子密度（ED）和静电势（ESP）场作为可扩展的学习表示仍然没有得到充分探索。这些连续场编码与结构-性质关系相关的互补空间和电子信息，特别是孔隙几何形状和客体-框架相互作用，但昂贵的第一原理计算、存储要求和系统对齐数据集的稀缺限制了它们的更广泛使用。在这里，我们介绍 MOFFieldBench，这是一个多模态基准，由大约 46,000 个 MOF 组成，具有一对一排列的晶体结构、ED 场和 ESP 场。
abstract: arXiv:2610.27036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) predominantly rely on atomic structures, whereas electron-density (ED) and electrostatic-potential (ESP) fields remain underexplored as scalable learning representations. These continuous fields encode complementary spatial and electronic information relevant to structure-property relationships, particularly pore geometry and guest-framework interactions, but costly first-principles calculations, storage requirements and the scarcity of systematically aligned datasets limit their broader use. Here we introduce MOFFieldBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising approximately 46,000 MOFs with one-to-one aligned crystallographic structures, ED fields and ESP fields. A unified workflow integrates field generation, error-controlled compression and sparse point-cloud representation, supporting field reconstruction, prediction of 13 material properties, multimodal property prediction and pairwise cross-modal retrieval. ED and ESP provide competitive representations for pore geometry, adsorption and separation properties. Multimodal fusion improves several prediction tasks relative to the best unimodal reference, supporting complementary predictive roles for atomic structures and electronic fields. Learned ED reconstruction closely approximates first-principles reference densities, while predicted-density initialization reduces self-consistent-field calculation time by 13.59% on average in paired tests. These results support electronic fields as practical, informative learning modalities and establish MOFFieldBench as a resource for studying representation choice, multimodal learning and electronic-field-driven MOF modelling.

title: Ammonia-Hydrogen Phase Equilibria in Planetary Envelopes from First-Principles-Based Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics
title_zh: 基于第一性原理的机器学习分子动力学研究行星包层中的氨-氢相平衡
summary: 氨和氢是太阳系内外行星的主要成分，但它们在行星包层中如何相互作用却鲜为人知。我们在经过密度泛函理论计算训练的机器学习原子间势的驱动下，对 500 至 4000 K 和 0.1 至 100 GPa 的氨-氢系统进行大规模两相共存模拟。根据这些，我们绘制了共存的富氢相和富氨相的组成，以及区分完全混溶条件和相分离条件的临界曲线。
abstract: arXiv:2610.27136v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ammonia and hydrogen are major constituents of planets within and beyond the solar system, yet how they interact in planetary envelopes is poorly known. We perform large-scale two-phase coexistence simulations of the ammonia-hydrogen system from 500 to 4000 K and 0.1 to 100 GPa, driven by machine-learning interatomic potentials trained on density functional theory calculations. From these we map the compositions of coexisting hydrogen-rich and ammonia-rich phases, and the critical curve that separates conditions of complete miscibility from those of phase separation. The critical temperature increases with pressure, from 500 K at 0.1 GPa to 2000 K near 30 GPa, and we find no phase separation at 3000 and 4000 K up to 100 GPa. The slope of the critical curve decreases substantially between 0.3 and 30 GPa, and the curve nearly flattens above about 30 GPa and 2000 K, where molecules begin to give way to atomic species. The coexistence curves are asymmetric with an ammonia-rich critical composition. For the expected envelope compositions, the phase boundary lies close to, and intersects, published thermal profiles of Uranus and Neptune, implying ammonia may be raining out in these planets today. In contrast, in warm sub-Neptunes such as TOI-270 d, ammonia and hydrogen are likely miscible in all proportions. Together with previous studies, our results suggest that silicates, water and ammonia separate from hydrogen in sequence as planets cool, with implications for their compositional, thermal and structural evolution.

title: Symmetry-Guided Machine Learning of Spin-Dependent Nonlinear Hall Response
title_zh: 自旋相关非线性霍尔响应的对称引导机器学习
summary: 即使线性霍尔响应消失，贝里曲率偶极子也可以产生非线性霍尔电流，但仅对称性并不能决定其大小或磁可调谐性。在蜂窝模型中检查结构对称性、力矩方向和载流子占据的相互作用。曲率图和能带求和偶极子被积函数揭示了费米能级附近的速度和占据窗口如何选择符号贡献。消除三重旋转允许非磁性偶极子垂直于幸存的镜子。通用磁重定向激活第二个组件并通过正值和负值调整两个组件。全局反转保留了偶极子，同时反转了固有的线性霍尔电导率，从而允许在均匀场平均下来自同等数量的反转域的有限体偶极子贡献。
abstract: arXiv:2610.28529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Berry-curvature dipole can produce a nonlinear Hall current even when the linear Hall response vanishes, but symmetry alone does not determine its magnitude or magnetic tunability. The interplay of structural symmetry, moment orientation, and carrier occupation is examined in a honeycomb model. Curvature maps and the band-summed dipole integrand reveal how velocity and the occupation window near the Fermi level select signed contributions. Removing threefold rotation permits a nonmagnetic dipole perpendicular to the surviving mirror. Generic magnetic reorientation activates the second component and tunes both components through positive and negative values. Global reversal preserves the dipole while reversing the intrinsic linear Hall conductivity, allowing a finite bulk dipole contribution from equally populated reversed domains under uniform-field averaging.A symmetry-constrained polynomial model predicts both dipole components for 256 held-out spin configurations, achieving coefficients of determination R² > 0.9995 at the reference chemical potential. At fixed carrier density, orientation-dependent shifts of the chemical potential modify the response and yield slightly larger prediction errors for the chosen model. Across the chemical-potential sweep,the prediction accuracy decreases more strongly for D_y,revealing an energy dependence of the surrogate's performance. Within semiclassical transport with a constant relaxation time, the calculated dipole determines the angular dependence of the quadratic current and its rectified and second-harmonic components. These results provide a quantitative representation of magnetic-orientation-dependent Berry-curvature dipoles and show how carrier occupation influences both the response and its predictability.

title: Decoding Perovskite Interfaces: Machine Learning Uncovers Geometry‐Matched Dual‐Site Hydrogen Bonding
title_zh: 解码钙钛矿界面：机器学习揭示几何匹配的双位点氢键
summary: 应用化学国际版，EarlyView。
abstract: Angewandte Chemie International Edition, EarlyView.

title: Interpretable Machine Learning Reveals Atom-Resolved VOCs Adsorption and Reactivity on Metal Oxides
title_zh: 可解释的机器学习揭示了原子解析的 VOC 在金属氧化物上的吸附和反应性
summary: 挥发性有机化合物 (VOC) 在金属氧化物上的吸附和反应控制着催化反应途径，但由于分子功能、表面化学和吸附几何结构紧密耦合，预测规则仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们报告了一种可转移吸附双塔框架（AdsDT），它独立编码分子和晶体特征，以直接从未松弛的 CIF 结构预测吸附能。通过在 Open Catalyst 2020 数据集上进行预训练并通过中间吸附系统逐步转移，AdsDT 能够快速构建金属氧化物-VOC 相互作用数据库，并与密度泛函理论计算（R2 = 0.85）高度一致。
abstract: The adsorption and reactivity of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) on metal oxides govern catalytic reaction pathways, yet predictive rules remain elusive because molecular functionality, surface chemistry, and adsorption geometry are strongly coupled. Here we report a transferable adsorption dual-tower framework (AdsDT) that independently encodes molecular and crystal features to predict adsorption energies directly from unrelaxed CIF structures. By pretraining on the Open Catalyst 2020 dataset and progressively transferring through intermediate adsorption systems, AdsDT enables rapid construction of metal oxides-VOCs interaction databases and achieves strong agreement with density functional theory calculations (R2 = 0.85). Using 816 TiO2 (anatase, 101)-VOCs adsorption configurations, we combine molecular fingerprints, SHAP analysis, and graph attention mapping to identify fragment-level and atom-resolved adsorption contribution. Saturated alkyl carbon environments increase predicted adsorption energies, whereas unsaturated and electronegative atoms, particularly carbonyl oxygen, favor stronger adsorption. Extension to eight representative metal oxides reveals material-dependent and functional-group correlation. Furthermore, a bond activation score integrating atomic attention, bond dissociation energy, and bond polarization links adsorption configurations to reaction pathways, showing that adsorption sites activate neighboring bonds through electronic redistribution rather than serving simply as cleavage centers. These results provide transferable atom-resolved descriptors for VOCs adsorption and catalytic reactivity across metal oxides.

title: SimuScan-Agent: language-model orchestration of synthetic-data-driven autonomous atomic force microscopy
title_zh: SimuScan-Agent：合成数据驱动的自主原子力显微镜的语言模型编排
summary: 原子力显微镜 (AFM) 能够实现纳米级表征，但大面积研究仍然缓慢，并且需要协调数据准备、模型训练和仪器操作。在这里，我们介绍 SimuScan-Agent，这是一个法学硕士精心设计的框架，可将自然语言目标转换为自适应 AFM 工作流程。将多模态形态源与物理信息模拟相结合，它可以生成带注释的合成数据集，无需手动对每个图像进行标记，训练和部署分割和表示学习模型，并使用在线检测和特定于类的采样目标来指导采集。
abstract: Atomic force microscopy (AFM) enables nanoscale characterization, but large-area investigations remain slow and require coordination of data preparation, model training and instrument operation. Here we introduce SimuScan-Agent, an LLM-orchestrated framework that translates natural-language objectives into adaptive AFM workflows. Combining multimodal morphological sources with physics-informed simulation, it generates annotated synthetic datasets without manual per-image labeling, trains and deploys segmentation and representation-learning models, and guides acquisition using online detections and class-specific sampling objectives. In simulations, probabilistic active exploration reduced measurements and sampled area by approximately 71% relative to raster scanning. Experimentally, SimuScan-Agent explored a ~10 mm² region by sampling 17.2% of available positions, estimating class-specific spatial distributions and assembling a morphological library to identify representative and atypical nanostructures. By linking synthetic-data generation, machine learning and adaptive acquisition through natural-language interaction, the framework lowers barriers to goal-directed nanoscale studies and offers a foundation for more intelligent, autonomous AFM systems that adapt experimental decisions to what they learn during measurement.

title: Strain-Dependent Wetting of Graphene
title_zh: 石墨烯的应变相关润湿
summary: 了解水如何润湿石墨烯对于预测和控制其在纳米流体、传感和能源应用中的行为至关重要。润湿的一个关键指标是液滴与表面形成的接触角，但石墨烯的实验测量范围很广，对于独立式石墨烯尚未达成共识。在这里，我们使用从头算精度的机器学习潜力，为这个未解决的问题提供原子第一原理预测，发现弱亲水接触角为 72.1 ± 1.5 度。更重要的是，我们发现石墨烯的润湿特性对机械应变高度敏感：拉伸应变使石墨烯的亲水性显着降低，而压缩应变会在液滴周围引起相干波纹，从而导致明显的各向异性润湿和接触角滞后。
abstract: arXiv:2601.20134v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding how water wets graphene is critical for predicting and controlling its behaviour in nanofluidic, sensing, and energy applications. A key measure of wetting is the contact angle made by a liquid droplet against the surface, yet experimental measurements for graphene span a wide range, with no consensus for free-standing graphene. Here, we use a machine learning potential with ab initio accuracy to provide an atomistic first-principles prediction for this unsolved problem, finding a weakly hydrophilic contact angle of 72.1 ± 1.5 deg. More importantly, we unveil that graphene's wetting properties are highly sensitive to mechanical strain: tensile strain makes graphene significantly less hydrophilic, while compressive strain induces coherent ripples around the droplet, resulting in pronounced anisotropic wetting and contact angle hysteresis. We show that there is a strong coupling between the three-phase contact line and the intrinsic thermal ripples of free-standing graphene, which contributes to this strain sensitivity. Our results demonstrate that the wettability of 2D membranes are governed not only by their chemistry but also by their dynamic morphology, introducing a new class of wetting behaviour unique to atomically thin materials that offers an additional explanation for variability in experimental measurements. These findings reveal that mechanical strain may be a practical route to controlling wetting in 2D nanomaterials-based technologies, with promising consequences for nanofluidic and nano-filtration applications.

title: Acceleration of CTQMC via Denoising Diffusion Models with Auxiliary Spectral Functions
title_zh: 通过具有辅助谱函数的去噪扩散模型加速 CTQMC
summary: 连续时间量子蒙特卡罗 (CTQMC) 杂质求解器是求解动态平均场理论 (DMFT) 方程的数值精确但昂贵的选择，欠采样产生的统计噪声给低温研究带来了重大挑战。这种噪声在采样的自能中尤其严重，在插入戴森方程时可能会破坏自洽环的稳定性。在这项工作中，我们基于在合成数据上训练的扩散模型架构，引入了费米子虚数时间格林函数的神经降噪器。
abstract: arXiv:2610.28542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous-time Quantum Monte Carlo (CTQMC) impurity solvers are a numerically exact, but expensive, option for solving the Dynamical Mean Field Theory (DMFT) equations, with statistical noise from undersampling presenting a major challenge to low temperature studies. This noise is especially egregious within the sampled self-energy, which can destabilize the self-consistency loop upon insertion into the Dyson equation. In this work, we introduce a neural denoiser for fermionic imaginary time Green's functions based on the diffusion model architecture trained on synthetic data. The network predicts positive and normalized auxiliary spectral functions consistent with the noisy imaginary axis CTQMC data, which is then refined via autodifferentiation to match the measured self-energy, its first two high-frequency moments, and impurity occupation similar to the Constrained Residual Minimization (CRM) method. This leads to Green's functions and self-energies that are causal by design. Through this denoising framework we are able to reduce the required CTQMC measurement steps by a factor of 10-100. We benchmark our method with a half-filled Hubbard model on a Bethe lattice, a two-patch Dynamical Cluster Approximation (DCA) of the two-dimensional Hubbard model, and the SrVO₃ system. We reproduce the Mott transition upon increasing Coulomb interaction for the half-filled Hubbard model with only 5000 CTQMC measurements, the pseudogap transition for the DCA two-dimensional Hubbard model with only 5×10⁵ measurements, and match the spectral function of SrVO₃ with 50 times fewer measurements than the reference. Since we generate auxiliary spectral functions, we recover the approximate spectral functions of the systems for free without performing analytic continuation.

title: Effective Atom Theory: Gradient-Driven Materials Design
title_zh: 有效原子理论：梯度驱动材料设计
summary: 我们引入有效原子理论（EAT），它将离散原子恒等式嵌入到连续可微空间中。在优化过程中，位点经过临时有效的混合物，然后被驱动为完全离散的、物理上可实现的原子。这使得 DFT 和 MLIP 中基于梯度的优化成为可能，从而比离散方法产生数量级的加速。 EAT 在 128 个原子电池中恢复了 NaCl 的精确基态，重建了 Cu-Pd 相图，优化了用于析氧的高熵氧化物，并发现了 SrTiO3 所示的键合拓扑。
abstract: arXiv:2509.07180v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce Effective Atom Theory (EAT), which embeds discrete atomic identities into a continuous differentiable space. During optimization, sites pass through temporary effective mixtures, then are driven to fully discrete, physically realizable atoms. This enables gradient-based optimization in DFT and MLIPs, yielding orders-of-magnitude acceleration over discrete methods. EAT recovers the exact ground state of NaCl in a 128 atom cell, reconstructs the Cu-Pd phase diagram, optimizes high-entropy oxides for oxygen evolution, and discovers bonding topologies as demonstrated for SrTiO3.

title: INCARBench: A Benchmark for Scientific Configuration in VASP INCAR by Large Language Models
title_zh: INCARBench：大型语言模型在 VASP INCAR 中科学配置的基准
summary: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地被集成到第一原理计算工作流程中，但人们对它们配置科学计算的能力仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们介绍 INCARBench，这是一个通过配置生成和修复任务评估维也纳从头算仿真包 (VASP) 输入配置的法学硕士的基准。评估 19 种模型配置揭示了当前前沿模型之间的巨大功能差异。虽然一些模型实现了较高的语义和策略准确性，但任务关键正确性仍然大大降低，这表明参数级正确性并不一定意味着科学有效的配置。
abstract: arXiv:2606.23571v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into first-principles computational workflows, yet their ability to configure scientific calculations remains poorly understood. Here, we introduce INCARBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on input configuration for the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP) through both configuration generation and repair tasks. Evaluating 19 model configurations reveals substantial capability differences among current frontier models. While several models achieve high semantic and policy accuracy, task-critical correctness remains substantially lower, demonstrating that parameter-level correctness does not necessarily imply scientifically valid configurations. Failure analysis shows that errors concentrate in physically coupled settings involving DFT+U, magnetism, and correlated materials, where multiple constraints must be satisfied simultaneously. Repair evaluation further reveals that correcting incorrect settings and preserving already-valid configurations are distinct capabilities, with configuration preservation remaining a major challenge. These findings establish scientific configuration as a measurable capability of large language models and provide a foundation for developing more reliable AI systems for computational materials science.

title: Learning the Geometry of Materials Space with Trained Neural Tangent Kernels
title_zh: 使用训练有素的神经正切核学习材料空间的几何形状
summary: 经过训练来预测材料属性的神经网络学习其物理内容可能难以提取的表示。我们使用神经正切核（NTK），在训练参数下进行评估，来恢复网络学习到的几何形状，该网络仅根据元素组成来预测超导转变温度。使用经过训练的 NTK 进行的核岭回归可以很好地再现网络的预测性能，并且大大优于使用初始核进行的回归。谱分析和多维尺度揭示了由少数方向主导的几何形状。聚类和局部邻域分析将化合物组织成可识别的超导族，并将材料与相关化学和相关电子特性联系起来，尽管 T_c 存在显着差异。
abstract: arXiv:2610.27412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks trained to predict materials properties learn representations whose physical content can be difficult to extract. We use the neural tangent kernel (NTK), evaluated at trained parameters, to recover the geometry learned by a network that predicts superconducting transition temperatures from elemental composition alone. Kernel ridge regression with the trained NTK closely reproduces the network's predictive performance and substantially outperforms regression with the initial kernel. Spectral analysis and multidimensional scaling reveal a geometry dominated by a small number of directions. Clustering and local neighborhood analysis organize compounds into recognizable superconducting families and connect materials with related chemical and correlated-electron properties despite substantial differences in T_c. These results establish trained tangent kernels as practical probes of learned materials representations, connecting property prediction with the exploration of materials space.

title: CrystalAR: Autoregressive Modeling for Symmetric Crystal Generation
title_zh: CrystalAR：对称晶体生成的自回归建模
summary: 深度生成建模在晶体生成方面取得了显着进展。鉴于晶体结构固有的丰富对称性，最近的工作试图将空间群对称性明确地纳入生成模型中，从而能够更有效地探索新颖的对称模板。然而，引入对称模板增加了原子种类和晶体学位点之间化学计量关系的组合复杂性，同时在离散晶体学模板的灵活探索和将这些模板忠实地实现为连续三维结构之间产生了基本的张力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 CrystalAR，这是一个统一的自回归框架，可以在单个生成序列中对威科夫对称模板和完整的晶体结构进行建模。
abstract: arXiv:2610.27762v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep generative modeling has achieved remarkable progress in crystal generation. Given the rich symmetries inherent in crystalline structures, recent work has sought to explicitly incorporate space-group symmetry into generative models, enabling more effective exploration of novel symmetry templates. Yet introducing symmetry templates increases the combinatorial complexity of stoichiometric relationships between atomic species and crystallographic sites, while creating a fundamental tension between flexible exploration of discrete crystallographic templates and faithful realization of these templates as continuous three-dimensional structures. To address these challenges, we propose CrystalAR, a unified autoregressive framework that models Wyckoff symmetry templates and complete crystal structures within a single generative sequence. Specifically, CrystalAR reformulates continuous coordinate generation as a symmetry-conditioned hierarchy of discrete spatial localization decisions, autoregressively refining the positions of all symmetry-inequivalent sites across resolution levels while jointly modeling their spatial configuration within each level. This discrete hierarchical formulation further enables constraint-aware search over both crystallographic templates and geometric realizations. As a result, CrystalAR retains strong symmetry-template generation capability while achieving competitive de novo generation performance and template-free crystal structure prediction (CSP) accuracy. These results suggest that symmetry-template generation can be retained alongside broadly competitive de novo generation performance and competitive CSP without reliance on symmetry templates retrieved from prior data, providing a promising alternative paradigm for symmetry-preserving crystal generation.

title: TexFlow: learning crystallographic texture on SO(3) manifold via normalizing flows
title_zh: TexFlow：通过归一化流学习 SO(3) 流形上的晶体纹理
summary: 晶体织构是一种重要的微观结构特征，它统计地描述了多晶材料中晶粒的取向。传统的纹理分析依赖于方向分布函数和极图，这对于解释给定材料样本的纹理至关重要，但它们本身并不能为过程-结构-性能联系的预测建模提供直接的框架。基于数据和机器学习的方法提供了解决这一差距的方法；然而，一个关键的挑战在于开发能够解释轮换的多种结构的表示和学习框架。特别是，许多现有的机器学习技术是针对欧几里德数据设计的，因此不容易应用于非欧几里德群 SO(3) 中的旋转。
abstract: arXiv:2610.28363v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Crystallographic texture is an important microstructural feature that statistically describes the orientations of grains in polycrystalline materials. Conventional texture analysis relies on the orientation distribution functions and pole figures, which are essential for interpreting the texture of a given material specimen but do not, by themselves, provide a direct framework for predictive modeling of process-structure-property linkages. Data- and machine learning-based approaches offer a means to address this gap; however, a key challenge lies in developing representations and learning frameworks that account for the manifold structure of rotations. In particular, many existing machine learning techniques are designed for Euclidean data and therefore are not readily applicable to rotations in the non-Euclidean group SO(3). Here we introduce TexFlow, a conditional normalizing flow framework for texture modeling that learns a probability distribution over rotations in SO(3) by construction. Rotations are encoded in a six-dimensional Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization representation which is then mapped back to valid rotations RinSO(3). The framework supports conditional probabilistic modeling of texture p(R|c), where c may represent processing parameters like temperature or deformation state. To complement conventional texture-analysis visualizations, such as pole figures and sections of the orientation distribution function, we further introduce Hopf-fibration visualizations as a compact global representation of texture. TexFlow is validated on both unconditional and conditional experimental and simulated texture datasets spanning diverse material systems. We show that TexFlow can accurately capture multimodal textures and their conditional evolution, providing a data-driven framework for establishing process-texture linkages.

title: LatticeMind: A Validation-Gated Agentic Framework for Density Functional Theory Workflows
title_zh: LatticeMind：密度泛函理论工作流程的验证门代理框架
summary: 第一原理计算很少是单个求解器调用：它们是多阶段工作流程，其中结构、设置和保存的密度必须在相关阶段之间正确传递。语言模型可以编写有效的单个输入，但一旦阶段链接起来，可靠性就会崩溃：即使在求解器运行时，丢失的依赖项、错误的文件切换或幻觉的关键字也可能使结果无效，并且此类错误只有在昂贵的执行后才会出现。我们引入了 LatticeMind，这是一个验证门控代理框架，可将自然语言请求转换为可执行、可检查的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 项目。工作流合同指定所需的阶段、文件和依赖项；
abstract: arXiv:2610.26869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles calculations are rarely single solver calls: they are multistage workflows in which structures, settings, and saved densities must pass correctly between dependent stages. Language models can write a valid single input, but reliability collapses once stages are chained: a dropped dependency, wrong file handoff, or hallucinated keyword can invalidate results even when the solver runs, and such errors surface only after costly execution. We introduce LatticeMind, a validation-gated agentic framework that converts natural-language requests into executable, checkable density functional theory (DFT) projects. A workflow contract specifies required stages, files, and dependencies; deterministic validators inspect the project before any solver launch; failed checks trigger bounded repair; and reports remain traceable to project files. On a 44-case RESCU benchmark spanning total-energy, density-of-states, band-structure, magnetic, phonon workflows, three non-flagship LLM backends reproduced every reference value; 119 of 132 runs passed on the first validated plan and the rest after one repair cycle. Ablations identify the workflow contract and pre-execution validation as the principal reliability mechanisms; a conventional trial-and-repair baseline reaches 71% at twice the token cost per success. The same architecture reproduces every reference value on a 19-case VASP benchmark, demonstrating transfer across solvers. Beyond these task families, LatticeMind generated and validated the 23 inputs of a multistage study of Rh-induced electronic responses at a Rh₆/InₓGa₁₋ₓN photocatalyst interface. These results establish workflow contracts, deterministic validation, bounded repair, and traceable records as a practical foundation for reliable AI-assisted scientific computing, where preventable errors are caught before execution and the solver is never the first validator.

title: Probabilistic denoising for reliable signal extraction in spectroscopy
title_zh: 用于光谱学中可靠信号提取的概率去噪
summary: 虽然深度学习为科学研究提供了强大的能力，但其应用往往因缺乏定量可靠性而受到阻碍。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个概率去噪框架，该框架同时从噪声数据中提取去噪信号和元素预测不确定性。我们在三维角度分辨光发射光谱数据上演示了这种方法，表明该模型可靠地从泊松分布的噪声中恢复了铜酸盐超导体的光谱特征，平均每个体素只有0.02个电子。至关重要的是，我们表明这些预测的不确定性可以传播到随后的超导间隙分析中，从而使用具有科学意义的误差条进行定量参数提取。
abstract: arXiv:2605.07819v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While deep learning offers powerful capabilities for scientific research, its application is often hindered by a lack of quantitative reliability. To address this, we introduce a probabilistic denoising framework that simultaneously extracts denoised signals and element-wise predictive uncertainties from noisy data. We demonstrate this approach on three-dimensional angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy data, showing that the model reliably recovers the spectral features of a cuprate superconductor from Poisson-distributed noise with an average count of only 0.02 electrons per voxel. Crucially, we show that these predicted uncertainties can be propagated into subsequent superconducting gap analyses, enabling quantitative parameter extraction with scientifically meaningful error bars. Furthermore, we validate the broad applicability of our approach by successfully extending it to two-dimensional X-ray diffraction data. Ultimately, this approach establishes uncertainty-aware deep learning not merely as a visualization tool, but as a rigorous framework for scientific data analysis.

title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
title_zh: 用于稳健多视野光伏功率预测的混合 TFT-NBEATS 框架
summary: 准确的多层面光伏发电功率预测对于电网稳定、能源调度和光伏电池电网系统的高效运行至关重要。然而，现有模型往往无法共同捕获短期变异性和长期时间模式，同时缺乏统一的多视野能力和可解释性。为了解决这些限制，本研究提出了一种新颖的混合深度学习框架，该框架将时间融合变压器 (TFT) 和 N-BEATS 集成在基于注意力的融合架构中。所提出的模型利用 TFT 来学习短期时间依赖性和动态特征重要性，而 N-BEATS 通过可解释的基础分解来捕获长期趋势和季节性成分。
abstract: arXiv:2610.27155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate multi-horizon photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential for grid stability, energy scheduling, and the efficient operation of PVbatterygrid systems. However, existing models often fail to jointly capture short-term variability and long-term temporal patterns, while lacking unified multi-horizon capability and interpretability. To address these limitations, this study proposes a novel hybrid deep learning framework that integrates a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and N-BEATS within an attention-based fusion architecture. The proposed model leverages TFT to learn short-term temporal dependencies and dynamic feature importance, while N-BEATS captures long-term trend and seasonal components through interpretable basis decomposition. An adaptive attention mechanism dynamically fuses both branches, enabling balanced multi-scale learning. The framework simultaneously generates forecasts for 30-minute, 2-hour, 6-hour, 12-hour, and 24-hour horizons within a single unified pipeline. The model is evaluated using multi-year real-world datasets from the Desert Knowledge Australia Solar Centre (DKASC). Experimental results demonstrate superior performance over statistical, machine learning, and deep learning baselines. The proposed model achieves RMSE values of 42.35, 46.27, 52.29, and 48.11 across the 20162017, 2023, 2024, and 20252026 datasets, respectively, corresponding to a 3540% reduction compared to the best baseline (TFT). Additionally, MAPE remains below 5% across all datasets, indicating high predictive accuracy and stability. The model also provides interpretability through attention visualization and trendseasonality decomposition, and is deployed on a cloud-based platform for real-time forecasting. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework is robust, interpretable, and suitable for practical renewable energy applications.

title: Generalized Spin Groups and Applications to Magnons
title_zh: 广义自旋群及其在磁振子中的应用
summary: 自旋群为各向同性海森堡模型提供了自然对称框架，其中自旋和晶格自由度是可分离的。他们最近在描述电子能带结构、磁振子能带拓扑和输运现象方面发现了广泛的应用。然而，描述磁振子的典型自旋哈密顿量不仅包含各向同性海森堡交换，还包含自旋轨道耦合（SOC）引起的各向异性相互作用，包括Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用、伽玛交换和单离子各向异性（SIA），这些相互作用强烈影响磁振子性质。最近，一些研究还揭示了交流磁体中的相对论磁振子输运现象。
abstract: arXiv:2610.28024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin groups provide the natural symmetry framework for the isotropic Heisenberg model, in which spin and lattice degrees of freedom are separable. They have recently found broad applications in describing electronic band structure, magnon band topology, and transport phenomena. However, a typical spin Hamiltonian describing magnons contains not only isotropic Heisenberg exchange but also anisotropic interactions induced by spin-orbit coupling (SOC), including the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, the Gamma exchange, and the single-ion anisotropy (SIA), which strongly influence magnon properties. More recently, some studies have also revealed relativistic magnon transport phenomena in altermagnets. Such systems typically exhibit partial spin-lattice locking, but are commonly assumed to be described by conventional magnetic groups. Here, we develop a systematic symmetry framework, generalized spin groups, for magnons. We first classify the symmetries of Heisenberg, DM, Gamma, and SIA interactions. The resulting classification contains 6 spin-only groups, together with a total of 161 nontrivial spin groups. The symmetries of magnetically ordered phases are then obtained through spontaneous symmetry breaking of the corresponding parent groups for spin Hamiltonians. We also identify 6 spin-only groups for ordered states, which generate 90, 264, 157, 264, 387, and 598 nontrivial spin groups, respectively. Finally, we apply generalized spin groups to the magnon thermal conductivity and spin conductivity tensors and derive all the symmetry-allowed forms. Our results provide a unified symmetry framework for analyzing magnon transport both with and without SOC, yielding more refined constraints on magnon responses.

title: Graph-Theoretic Analysis of Phase Optimization Complexity in Variational Wave Functions for Heisenberg Antiferromagnets
title_zh: 海森堡反铁磁体变分波函数相位优化复杂度的图论分析
summary: 我们研究了学习海森堡反铁磁体基态相结构的计算复杂性。将希尔伯特空间表示为加权图，变分能量定义了加权 XY 模型，对于 Z2 相，该模型简化为该图上的经典反铁磁 Ising 模型。对于固定振幅，重建基态波函数的符号因此减少为加权最大割实例。这将波函数的符号优化直接与组合优化联系起来。
abstract: arXiv:2602.04943v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the computational complexity of learning the ground state phase structure of Heisenberg antiferromagnets. Representing Hilbert space as a weighted graph, the variational energy defines a weighted XY model that, for Z₂ phases, reduces to a classical antiferromagnetic Ising model on that graph. For fixed amplitudes, reconstructing the signs of the ground state wavefunction thus reduces to a weighted Max-Cut instance. This links sign optimization of wavefunctions directly to combinatorial optimization.

title: Lattice symmetry breaking and strain control of single-q magnetism in Na₃Co₂SbO₆
title_zh: Na₃Co2SbO₆中单q磁性的晶格对称性破缺与应变控制
summary: 区分单 q 与多 q 磁性限制了微观自旋哈密顿量。在这里，我们通过与晶格的耦合确定了候选基塔耶夫磁体 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 的基态。高分辨率中子衍射揭示了磁转变时自发的单斜晶向三斜晶畸变，与三q Na2Co2TeO6 中不存在可检测到的晶格对称性破缺相反。与应变选择性磁响应一起，这确定了 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 中所提出的对称性保持双 q 态的单 q 级。沿低对称性面内方向的单轴压缩实现了磁场训练无法实现的域选择，揭示了主域的固有场感应相边界。
abstract: arXiv:2610.27663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distinguishing single-q from multi-q magnetism constrains microscopic spin Hamiltonians. Here we determine the ground state of the candidate Kitaev magnet Na₃Co₂SbO₆ through its coupling to the lattice. High-resolution neutron diffraction reveals a spontaneous monoclinic-to-triclinic distortion at the magnetic transition, in contrast to the absence of detectable lattice-symmetry breaking in triple-q Na₂Co₂TeO₆. Together with strain-selective magnetic responses, this identifies single-q order in Na₃Co₂SbO₆ over the proposed symmetry-preserving double-q state. Uniaxial compression along a low-symmetry in-plane direction achieves the domain selection that magnetic-field training could not, revealing the intrinsic field-induced phase boundaries of the dominant domain. These results establish strain as a symmetry-conjugate field for magnetic domains and highlight magnetoelastic coupling as a route to diagnose, manipulate, and potentially tune magnetic states.
